lines.jp:
そして潮の流れも色も通常に復しつつある波の間に間、信天翁号の上では。
　朔屋に対しての論功行賞の真っ最中であった───
　船に揚がって、『真珠』の効用か、深く染みこみはせず、船員服の上で細かな粒に弾かれる、赤葡萄酒の滴をぱんぱん払い落としている間にも、朔屋の為した事が船内に知れ渡っていたのである。
lines.en:
Meanwhile, between waves whose currents and colors were returning to normal, aboard the Albatross-- 
Naomasa's meritorious service was being rewarded. 
By the time he climbed aboard and began patting the red-wine droplets from his sailor's clothes--the pearl's effect had made them bead instead of soaking deeply--word of his deed had spread throughout the ship.

lines.jp:
すなわち。
　舳先の棒に立たされ、皆から罵声を浴びせかけられている最中であった。
　海賊時代を髣髴とさせた。
　青年を責め立てる文句も、古式よろしく伝統を踏まえていた。
lines.en:
That is to say: 
they had driven him onto the bowsprit and were showering him with abuse. 
It recalled the old days of piracy. 
Even the charges hurled at the young man observed ancient tradition.
Juuuump!
Juuuump!

lines.jp: 航海士の双子が、やいのやいのと責め、囃したてながら両手を振り上げ腿を跳ね上げ、朔屋の後ろで炎に昂奮した蛮族のようにしきりにぴょんぴょん跳びはねている。
lines.en: The navigator twins hectored and egged him on, flinging up both hands and kicking their knees high as they bounced madly behind Naomasa like barbarians roused by fire.

lines.jp: 「さっさとしやがれ、こっちゃまだ酒残ってふらふらしてんだからよ」
lines.en: Get on with it. Some of us are still staggering from all that liquor.

lines.jp: 「ニャアアア」
lines.en: Mrrrraaaow!

lines.jp: 水夫長の渋面も、深酒の後でやや迫力に欠けるが、それら補いをつけるように宗右衛門猫が、でんと老水夫の隣に腰を据えて、朔屋に大口開けて火のような舌をそよがせている始末の。何故猫にまでこうも怒られなければならないのか、とんと見当もつかぬ朔屋に、
lines.en: The Boatswain's sour face had lost some force after his heavy drinking, but Souemon the cat appeared determined to make up the difference. Planted grandly beside the old sailor, he opened his jaws at Naomasa and fluttered a tongue like flame. Naomasa had no notion why even the cat should be so furious with him, until--

lines.jp: 「ああそうだった直の字、お前ぇがな、泪の口紅べったり拭ったあれな、あの水な、宗右衛門の取り分だったんだわ」
lines.en: Oh, right, Nao. That water you used after wiping all Namida's rouge off your mouth? That was Souemon's ration.

lines.jp: なるほどそれでは黒猫がお怒りになっても仕方がない。宗右衛門、船の中で一等偉いご意見番、彼は常に一番良い水と一番良い食料を取る権利を行使する。
lines.en: No wonder the black cat was angry. Souemon, the highest and most respected elder aboard the Albatross, invariably exercised his right to the finest water and food on the ship.

lines.jp:
『人生は選択だよ、朔屋君。
　飛びこむ先が、海か主罐の中か。
　私としては、まあ海の方がこちらの手間にはならないかな』
lines.en:
Life is choice, Sakuya. 
The sea, or the main boiler: which will you jump into? 
Personally, I suppose the sea would save us some trouble down here.

lines.jp: 上甲板のど真ん中から唐突に突き出している伝声管からは、機関長も容赦なく督励している。朔屋は、さっきまでそんなところに伝声管など生えていなかった筈と首を捻った弾みに足を踏み外し、真っ逆様に海の中、といきかけて往生際の悪い事に辛うじて棒にしがみついたが、背中を下にぶら下がる様、棒に四肢を縛りつけられこれから丸焼きにされようという類人猿とよく似ていた。
lines.en: The Engineer mercilessly urged him on through a speaking tube that had abruptly sprouted from the very center of the upper deck. Naomasa tilted his head--surely no such tube had grown there a moment ago--and lost his footing. He nearly plunged headfirst into the sea, but made one undignified last struggle and caught the spar. Hanging beneath it on his back, he resembled an ape bound by all four limbs to a spit and awaiting the fire.

lines.jp: 「余計な時に、ろくでもないコトばっか言うから、こんなコトになったじゃないか」
lines.en: You're always saying awful things at the worst possible time. That's what caused all this.

lines.jp: 「僕らの中には、まだ立てないのだっているんだヨ？」
lines.en: Some of us still can't even stand, you know?

lines.jp: 日頃温厚な下級水夫君達までもが、憤懣やるかたなしと言った相で舳先の上で震える朔屋を睨みつけ足踏みならしているとあっては、この船上裁判、朔屋に味方して弁護する者はいないようであった。
lines.en: When even the ordinarily mild junior sailors glared at Naomasa trembling above the bow and stamped their feet in helpless indignation, it appeared this shipboard trial had not appointed a single soul to his defense.

lines.jp: そう、かくの如く───
lines.en: Yes, indeed---

lines.jp: 皆が朔屋に酬いようとしているのは、彼が海を元に戻してきた事を褒賞しようというのではない。朔屋が海底に降りていった事を知るのは泪と智里のみであり、智里はこれこの通り、
lines.en: What everyone wished to repay was not Naomasa's restoration of the sea. Only Namida and Tomosato knew he had descended to the seabed, and Tomosato, as could plainly be seen--

lines.jp:
「間違っちゃあいねえわな。
　諦めろや、朔屋よう。
　なぁに一瞬のことだ」
lines.en:
Can't say they're wrong. 
 Give it up, Sakuya. 
 It'll all be over in a second.

lines.jp: 皆に説明する気など皆無のようだし、だいたい殺し屋の言動は意味不明瞭な事でも船内に知れ渡っている。口を聞いたところで余計の誤解を招きかねない。
lines.en: --had no intention whatsoever of explaining matters to anyone. Besides, the assassin's incomprehensible words and deeds were famous throughout the ship. If Tomosato opened his mouth, he might merely create another misunderstanding.

lines.jp:
では泪は、と言えば、朔屋を非難糾弾する輪にこそ入っていないものの、皆から離れて一人の下級水夫君と話しこんでいる最中で、青年をどういう扱いが待ち構えていようと、それには大した興味がないようだった。
　そもそも、朔屋など塩辛某にやりこめられて悄気ていたのが関の山で、今回の現象を収めたのは結局彼女なのであり、泪は泪はと頼るのにも限度があろう。
lines.en:
As for Namida, she had not joined the circle denouncing Naomasa, but stood apart in earnest conversation with one junior sailor. Whatever treatment awaited the young man appeared to interest her little. 
After all, Naomasa had accomplished no more than being browbeaten by Salted-Somebody and hanging his head; Namida was the one who had ultimately resolved the affair. There had to be some limit to his constant reliance upon her.

lines.jp:
「……判った、判りましたようっ。
　僕のせいですよ、ええなんもかも……。
　飛びますよ、飛びゃあいいんでしょう」
lines.en:
...Fine. I understand! 
 It's my fault, yes, all of it... 
 I'll jump! That's what you want, isn't it?

lines.jp: ぐすぐすと啜り泣く、鬱期の朔屋は、同じ能無しでもまだ普段のお調子者の方がましと十人が十人ともそう断ずるほど鬱陶しさに湿っぽく、不愉快な事極まりない。朔屋は棒に掴まったまま救いを求めるように頭を廻らせた、ところで誰も青年を擁護する者などおらず、どころか、べちゃんと、空から落ちてきて青年の両目を塞いだものがある。
lines.en: Sniffling and sobbing, Naomasa in a depressive spell was so damply tiresome, so utterly disagreeable, that ten people out of ten would have preferred his ordinary cheerful incompetence. Still clinging to the spar, he turned his head in search of salvation. No one defended him. Worse, something dropped from the sky with a wet splat and covered both his eyes.

lines.jp: 彼の末路を見物するように最前より空をくるくる回っていた信天翁の糞である。鳥さえも痺れを切らしたのかも知れない。
lines.en: It was the droppings of the albatross that had been circling overhead, apparently watching his final moments. Perhaps even the bird had lost patience.

lines.jp: 「うぎゃああ臭いようううっっっ！」
lines.en: Gyaaah! It stinks so baaad!

lines.jp:
たまらず拭い落とそう、と手を離せば待ち受けている運命は判りきって、がくんと状態が垂れ下がって、腿で棒を挟んで持ちこたえていたのも僅かな間、朔屋は自決する意地さえ見せず、落ちていく、情けなく落ちていく。
　まあ、糞に塗れた顔も、海水で洗えば綺麗にもなろう。
lines.en:
The fate awaiting him if he released the spar to wipe it away was perfectly obvious. His upper body sagged; for a few moments his thighs clung on. Naomasa could not summon even the pride to cast himself off. He fell--pathetically, miserably fell. 
Well, seawater ought at least to wash his befouled face clean.

lines.jp:
先ほどは猿にも喩えたが、まだ水に映じた月に向かって飛びかかっては落ちる猿の方が勇ましく、朔屋の落ちゆく姿は皆の記憶に残った。不様の見本として。
　波間に呑まれて水音と飛沫が高い。
lines.en:
The narrator had compared him to an ape, but even the ape that leaps at the moon reflected in water and falls possesses greater courage. Naomasa's descent remained in every witness's memory as the very model of disgrace. 
The waves swallowed him in a tower of spray and sound.

lines.jp:
深く落ちこんだが、すぐさまぷかり浮いてきて、カツオノエボシのように頭を覗かせぱしゃぱしゃと水をかく、本人も忘れていたようだが、『真珠』の効果はまだ続いたらしい。
　しかしそれが幸いだったのかどうか。
　波間できょとんと浮かぶ朔屋の顔は、船員達の神経を鑢で逆撫でしたと見え、
lines.en:
He sank deep, then promptly bobbed up again, poking his head from the water like a Portuguese man-of-war and paddling noisily. Naomasa himself had apparently forgotten, but the pearl's effect continued. 
Whether this counted as good fortune was another matter. 
His blank face floating among the waves seemed to rasp the crew's nerves backward with a file--

lines.jp:
「なんじゃ、あいつ。
　平気の平左で浮かんできたぞ」
lines.en:
What's with him? 
Up he comes, cool as you please.

lines.jp:
「ぺっぺ、なんかまだ微妙にワインの味が残ってて、潮と混ざって、これ、
　うえええ……あ、痛、痛いッ」
lines.en:
Ptoo, ptoo. There's still a faint taste of wine, and mixed with the salt it's--- 
 Blegh... Ow! That hurts!

lines.jp: 朔屋、グルマン気取って潮の味など論評する暇もない。この男の溺れもがく様見れば少しは溜飲も下がるだろうという期待裏切られた船員達、特に双子が率先してあたりのガラクタ手当たり次第に水面の朔屋に向かって投げつけたのだ。
lines.en: Naomasa had no leisure to pose as a gourmand and review the flavor of the sea. The crew had expected the sight of him drowning and struggling to settle their stomachs; his easy survival cheated them. The twins in particular seized the initiative, snatching up every piece of junk within reach and pelting Naomasa on the water.

lines.jp: 「全然堪えてないみたい」
lines.en: Doesn't look like that bothered him at all.

lines.jp: 「こりゃ、一回じゃあ懲りないかな」
lines.en: Guess once won't teach him anything.

lines.jp: 『そもそも彼は、物事に懲りるという性格でもないでしょうに』
lines.en: He was never the sort to learn his lesson in the first place.

lines.jp:
「なら懲りるまで何度でもやってもらおうや。
　おら朔屋、もう一度だ。
　今度は竜骨潜りしてこい」
lines.en:
Then we'll make him do it till he learns. 
Oi, Sakuya--again. 
This time, go under the keel.

lines.jp: 水夫長は投げ輪で朔屋を引きずり挙げたものの、当然温情からなどではなく、また舳先の棒に追いたてたし、
lines.en: The boatswain hauled Naomasa up with a throwing line, naturally not out of mercy, and drove him back onto the bowsprit.

lines.jp:
「さすがに、それは……息が続いても、
　背中の皮と肉がずる剥けになっちまいますよう……」
lines.en:
That really is too much... Even if my breath holds, 
the keel will strip the skin and flesh from my back...

lines.jp:
「御託はいいから。いいから───
　飛～～べっ！」
lines.en:
Enough excuses. Just do it--- 
 Juuuump!

lines.jp: 「そら飛～～べっ！」
lines.en: Come on, juuuump!

lines.jp: 双子は今度は回転式拳銃で狙いを着けて撃鉄を起こす始末の、躊躇っていては飛びこむよりひどい目に遭う事間違いなしの。
lines.en: This time the twins went so far as to aim their revolvers and cock the hammers. If he kept hesitating, there was no doubt he would suffer worse than a jump.

lines.jp: 「あーーーーーっっっ」
lines.en: Aaaaaaah!

lines.jp:
かくして船上に信天翁は舞い、海中へと朔屋は落ちていく。
　何度でも。何度でも。
lines.en:
Thus the albatross wheeled above the ship, and Naomasa fell into the sea. 
Again. Again.

lines.jp: それでも、打ち身と擦り傷を全身にこさえただけですんだのは、さすがこの男、悪運の持ち主と言うべきか。
lines.en: That he escaped with no more than bruises and scrapes all over his body was perhaps proof that, as always, the man possessed extraordinary luck.

lines.jp:
さて、この私刑の輪からやや離れて。
　時間は少し巻き戻り、舳先で泣き喚く朔屋が救い求めて見た泪の方。朔屋が怒りの形相下面々に舳先へ追い立てられる一方、共に船に戻った泪に、下級水夫君の一人がなにやら沈痛な面持ちで歩み寄る。
lines.en:
Now, a little apart from the circle of private punishment-- 
Time turns back slightly, toward Namida, whom Naomasa had watched for salvation while bawling on the bow. As the furious crew drove him onto the bowsprit, one junior sailor approached Namida, who had returned alongside him, with a deeply troubled face.

lines.jp: 「泪さん、あのね……ごめんなさい」
lines.en: Miss Namida... I'm sorry.

lines.jp: 「なあに？　男の子が、いきなり謝ってくるなんて」
lines.en: What is it? A young man suddenly coming to apologize to me.
This---

lines.jp: 彼が握った手開いて泪に差し出したのは、乳白色に虹を纏った白い粒。朔屋との口づけの後で床にこぼれた真珠。
lines.en: He opened his clenched hand and offered Namida a milky-white bead wrapped in iridescence: one of the pearls that had spilled onto the floor after her kiss with Naomasa.

lines.jp:
「僕、あの後、
　泪さんの部屋から戻った後……。
　服の中にこれが入ってて……」
lines.en:
Afterward... 
after I came back from your room... 
I found this inside my clothes...

lines.jp:
「でもあのっ。
　僕、盗んだりなんかしていない、です。
　本当に、知らないうちに───」
lines.en:
But, um-- 
I didn't steal it. I didn't. 
It was there before I even knew--

lines.jp:
「でもそんなのは、言い訳だ。
　だから、ごめんなさい。
　返します。罰だったら受けます」
lines.en:
But that's only an excuse. 
So I'm sorry. 
I'm giving it back. If there's a punishment, I'll take it.

lines.jp:
「……謝る事なんて、なぁんにも。
　貴方が盗んだりなんてしてないこと、
　わかっているから」
lines.en:
...There is nothing--nothing at all--for you to apologize for. 
I know perfectly well 
that you never stole it.

lines.jp:
「それは偶然に滑りこんだのよ、きっと。
　そんなものを、返してなんて言わないし」
lines.en:
It must have slipped in by chance. 
 I wouldn't ask you to return such a thing.

lines.jp: 「でも……こんな綺麗な真珠……」
lines.en: But... such a beautiful pearl...

lines.jp: 面伏せして、扱いあぐねたように手の中の白い珠へ、注ぐ眼差しは前髪の奥で見えないけれど、切なく涙を滲ませているのではないだろうかの、それくらい生真面目な面を持ち合わせているのが信天翁号の下級水夫達である。……この彼はやや行きすぎだとしても。
lines.en: He lowered his face toward the white bead in his palm, plainly at a loss. His eyes were hidden behind his fringe, but one could imagine them brimming with pained tears. Such earnestness belonged to the Albatross's junior sailors--though this particular boy carried it rather too far.

lines.jp:
そんな彼の前で。あの狂宴の一時に下級水夫を恣弄んでいたのがこの泪なら、腰を落として目線を合わせて、穏やかに、男を惑わす魔性ではなく、清濁合わせて抱擁するかの観世音の相を綻ばせてみせるのも、また同じ泪なのだった。
　手を差し延べて、下級水夫の掌に掌重ねて白い珠を握らせてやりながら、気易に額を合わせてもう一度笑みかけた。
lines.en:
Before him, Namida lowered herself until their eyes met. This was the same Namida who had abused the child-coded junior sailor during the mad revel. Now she showed neither the demonic allure that led men astray nor any denial of what had happened, but the merciful face of a goddess said to embrace both purity and corruption. 
She placed her palm over his, closed his fingers around the white bead, then touched her forehead lightly to his and smiled once more.

lines.jp:
「ふふ……っ。
　それはね、真珠とは少し違うのよ。
　貝の中で育ったものじゃない───
　それは」
lines.en:
Hee hee... 
That is not quite a pearl. 
It never grew inside a shell-- 
it is--

lines.jp: 「人魚の涙よ」
lines.en: A mermaid's tear.
